variance: 80 ACS person replicate weights; SDR factor 4/80
testing: two-sided normal test from the direct replicate-weight contrast standard error
extreme_probability_reporting: p and q values below positive IEEE-754 float precision are stored at the smallest positive float, flagged, and accompanied by their finite log10 values
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within each metric across non-suppressed state comparisons; suppressed states are not tested or included in the family; national q=p
